correctness.rationale: For nonantipodal endpoints, three Euclidean angle tests produce an exact belt-minus-cap conditional probability K; for antipodes the exact probability is zero and the continuous extension differs by 1/2. Funk--Hecke and Rodrigues give lambda_l=-(2+(-1)^l)/[8(l-1/2)(l+1/2)(l+3/2)] for l>=1, with zero constant eigenvalue and absolutely convergent addition-theorem expansion. Hence the exact Borel-measure deficit includes a nonnegative spectral sum and the correct antipodal penalty; equality requires all nonconstant moments zero and therefore the uniform measure. Canonical Hoeffding projection leaves order-three remainder of variance O(n^3), while finite-harmonic CLT and a uniform L2 truncation yield the chi-square chaos at scale n^2. The trace sum equals 1/2, giving sharp support supremum 1/4; the Hilbert--Schmidt sum equals (pi-3)/8, giving limit variance (pi-3)/16. The standalone checker from the complete result was run and returned ALL_CHECKS_PASSED, independently integrating 12 eigenvalues and the pair kernel and checking trace, variance and fixed-separation direct simulations. Neither numerical truncation nor simulation is treated as an infinite proof.
